reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000583 (the melody read from 000583a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 16); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Johann Schop's dates (1590–1664) are from our page for the tune JESUS BLEIBET MEINE FREUDE (content/hymns/tunes/jesus-bleibet-meine-freude.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1641.
